description: Umbilical cable, module to instrument
notes: *** GAUGE IS OPEN AND THREE DERIVATIONS ASSUME 24 AWG. *** 0005:91 computes a ~0.34 ohm round trip, breath-sense-link.md:100 a 0.168 ohm return term, and 0003:315 a whole signal-drop table - all at 24 AWG, which this row does not specify. A stranded Cat5e PATCH lead is commonly 26 or 28 AWG, at 1.6x to 2.6x the resistance. WHAT DECIDES IT: buy the lead, read the jacket print, or measure end-to-end DC resistance at E6. Note the trap - the well-argued STRANDED requirement below is exactly what makes a thinner gauge likely, and nobody connected the two. STRANDED not solid-core: solid core work-hardens and fractures under constant flexing, which is this cable's whole life. Shielded preferred. It is a CONSUMABLE - keep spares and replace at the first intermittency

part: RTV silicone - ALKOXY (alcohol) neutral cure, electronics-safe
description: Plate to oak, matrix diffuser, thumb plate - and the lid gasket
notes: NOT ACETOXY. The common hardware-store type releases acetic acid while curing, inside a sealed cavity holding two dev boards, a carrier, connectors and a pressure sensor. Compliant in shear so the oak's 0.6-0.9mm of cross-grain humidity movement does not fight the aluminium plate; stiff in compression so the plate is still backed under a key press. BEAD IT, DO NOT BUTTER IT - cure needs atmospheric moisture and runs ~2mm/day inwards, so a trapped full-face layer never cures. Keep it off both sensor ports (ADR 0003) | 2026-09-21: TWO JOBS NOW. Adhesive on the permanent joints above; GASKET on the lid-to-U joint, which opens on six fasteners (ADR 0009). Same tube. Lay the gasket bead on ONE face, let it skin, then clamp - a fresh bead glues the lid shut, which is the failure this change exists to avoid
